item.description:
### Added
- First-run onboarding guide with animated intro and completion celebration, four-step environment check, and auto-closing Full Disk Access permission guidance. - In-app Homebrew installation progress indicator and automatic Terminal PATH setup (`~/.zprofile`) upon Homebrew installation.
### Fixed
- Fixed official `Homebrew.pkg` signature verification to recognize Apple Developer ID Installer certificate chains and run silent system-authorized installation without external installer windows. - Removed misleading uninstalled status circles and focus-switch spinner flashes in the onboarding guide, and enlarged setup action buttons.
## 安装
1. 打开 DMG，将 `Cellar.app` 拖到 `Applications`。 2. 移除下载隔离属性：
```bash sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cellar.app ```
> 此版本使用 Apple Development 签名，未经 Apple 公证。

### Added
- Native macOS 26+ Apple Silicon app with task-oriented Home, Library, Discover, Environment, Maintenance, Settings, and About navigation. - Unified management for Homebrew Formulae and Casks, global npm packages bound to explicit Node environments, nvm-managed Node.js runtimes, Homebrew Taps, npm registries, and Oh My Zsh themes and plugins. - Guided Command Line Tools and verified official Homebrew installer setup on Home, plus local Cask `.app` icon resolution with CaskFlow fallback. - Enhanced Homebrew Cask uninstall with ownership-verified related-data cleanup, bounded confirmation plans, and optional one-shot macOS administrator authorization. - Unified Maintenance grid with Homebrew diagnostics, npm cache verification, batch installation, and bounded cleanup modals. - Configurable local file logging, session diagnostics redaction, Sparkle signed updates, drag-to-install DMG packaging, and full eight-language interface localization following system preferences by default.
### Improved
- App Store-style horizontal catalog cards with inline pending-update grouping, linked titles, and unified search and scope controls. - Receipt-styled Environment Information sheet in Settings displaying detected versions, paths, and controlled `PATH`.
### Fixed
- Hardened app termination, read-only subprocess cancellation, clean-machine startup without Node/npm or Command Line Tools, and sheet confirmation guards.
## 安装
1. 打开 DMG，将 `Cellar.app` 拖到 `Applications`。 2. 移除下载隔离属性：
```bash sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cellar.app ```
> 此版本使用 Apple Development 签名，未经 Apple 公证。
